all.description: Every release proof on Cloudflare, including a forced camera layer switch.

smoke.description: Export and the webhook smoke on Cloudflare.

camera-share.description: Camera and screen share between guests.

recording-rejoin.description: A guest rejoins during a Recording.

call-artifacts.description: Three guests with automatic Recording and Transcript, on the media plane CHALK_PROOF_MEDIA_PLANE selects. It has its own Space, so it runs beside the other nightly proofs.

long-call.description: Three guests held across media-access refreshes for at least ten minutes, with mic and camera toggles on a schedule. Opt-in: nightly only.

deploy-hold.description: Three calls of three guests held open while an operator deploys the API host (DEPLOY_HOLD_STARTED_FILE, DEPLOY_HOLD_DONE_FILE). Opt-in: nightly only.

leave.description: The candidate Leave against the published client on the same host and backend.

leave-own-sfu.description: The current client's Leave on the own SFU: acknowledgement, released capture, removed participant and media.

own-sfu-spaces.description: Finds or creates Promote's two own-SFU proof Spaces by slug and moves them to chalk_sfu. Run it before the release that adds the per-Space setting deploys.

offreason.description: Sync's media_off_reason extension over the WebSocket protocol.

chat-upload.description: A real chat attachment upload from an origin on no list: preflight, PUT, finalize and download against the storage bucket.
